svg.aria-label: Map of northern France showing St Joan of Arc's road: 1 Domrémy, 2 Vaucouleurs, 3 Chinon, 4 Poitiers, 5 Blois, 6 Orléans, 7 Patay, 8 Reims, 9 Paris, 10 Compiègne, 11 Beaurevoir and 12 Rouen, with Sainte-Catherine-de-Fierbois, Saint-Denis and other towns on the way, and her journey as a prisoner from Compiègne by Beaurevoir, Arras and Le Crotoy to Rouen

g.text: main places in her story, in order
Modern borders shown; in 1429 much of the north was held by England and Burgundy.
